full_prompt_en: This square historical cityscape painting surveys a broad cobbled street running from the foreground toward a distant cluster of pale buildings. A narrow canal parallels the street along its left side, partly screened by dark trees and crossed by a small bridge in the middle distance. The foreground opens in a wide fan of warm stone paving. At lower left, a yellow covered wagon stands near a few tiny figures and horses; at lower right, a dark carriage turns into the street. Other small carts, walkers, and riders diminish toward the central vanishing area. On the right, a large pale stone façade occupies the near edge, its repeated windows and horizontal courses drawn with careful perspective. A darker roofed building stands just beyond it, balancing the leafy bank and a domed structure on the left. Farther back, pitched roofs and distant towers create an irregular skyline. Above, a generous blue sky carries layered white and gray clouds, whose softened edges contrast with the architectural detail below. Daylight comes through the breaks in the clouds, illuminating the street and light façades while tree masses and recesses along the canal stay darker. The painting distinguishes tiny figures, wheels, window frames, masonry joints, and cobbles without making any one detail dominate. Warm cream and tan architecture is set against cool blue-gray water and sky, with deep green foliage anchoring the left foreground. The overall view is spacious and measured, using exact linear structure and atmospheric distance to make a busy street feel calm and continuous.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形历史城市风景画俯览一条宽阔卵石街道，它从前景通向远方一簇浅色建筑。一条狭窄运河沿街道左侧平行延伸，部分被深色树丛遮挡，中景有一座小桥横跨其上。前景暖石铺面向外扇形展开。左下方一辆黄色篷车停在几个小人物和马旁；右下方一辆深色马车转入街中。其余小车、行人和骑者向中央远处渐渐缩小。右边近处是一大面浅色石砌立面，重复的窗户与水平墙线按准确透视绘出。稍远处一栋深屋顶建筑平衡左侧多树的河岸和一座圆顶建筑。更后方，斜屋顶与远塔构成不规则天际线。上方宽阔蓝天承载层叠的白灰云朵，柔软云缘与下方建筑细节形成对比。日光从云间透入，照亮街道和浅色立面；运河沿线的树团与凹处则较暗。画面分辨得出细小人物、车轮、窗框、砌缝和铺石，却不让任何局部喧宾夺主。暖奶油色与褐色建筑对应冷蓝灰的水和天空，深绿植被稳住左前景。整体视野开阔而有节制，以精确的线性结构和空气远近使热闹街道显得平静且连贯。
style_prompt_en: Detailed representational painting joins exact perspective to gently atmospheric distance. Fine architectural and surface marks remain crisp in the nearer plane and gradually soften and shrink toward the horizon. Warm limestone, tan, and muted gold areas contrast with blue-gray expanses and deep green shadow masses. Broken clouds scatter daylight across selected planes, leaving recesses cooler and darker. Repeated small motifs bring human scale to broad spatial corridors without interrupting the larger geometry. The result is luminous, orderly, and quietly expansive, with many particulars integrated into a unified view.
style_prompt_zh: 细致具象绘画把准确透视与柔和空气远景结合。近处精细结构和表面痕迹保持清楚，朝地平线逐渐软化并缩小。暖石灰、棕褐与低饱和金色区域对照蓝灰的大面积色域和深绿阴影体块。破碎云层把日光撒在部分平面上，凹处更冷更暗。重复小纹样为宽阔空间通道带来人的尺度，却不打断大几何结构。结果明亮、有序而安静开阔，众多细节融入统一视野。
theme_en: A sunlit historic street with carriages beside a narrow canal
theme_zh: 阳光下马车行经狭窄运河旁的历史街道
name: Bernardo Bellotto
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
